nodes.title: Her once-a-day home greeting is a PRE-RENDERED clip, never live TTS (PRODUCT-DESIGN-V2 §3.3: no name in it): a fixed pool of 27 short lines (3 per part of day per language, grown-up register, no gendered Hindi verb about the child) in server/face-puppet/greetings.js; GET /api/tutors/greeting picks one per child per IST day (stable all day); clips are rendered once by scripts/character/render-greetings.mjs (Diya DragonHD, needs keys) with viseme sidecars; until rendered the response has clip:null and she only glances. Client: src/face-puppet/useDailyGreeting.ts plays it after the first tap (never at page load), lip-synced via clipBridge, then emits a faceCues gaze 'start' (new target, [data-testid=start-lesson]); App applies docs/patches/to-app/004 (KakshaHome → HomeView → Comms → Teacher meters/floor). Verified headless (evals/face-puppet/greeting-shots.mjs): silent before the tap, speaks after it, silent on a same-day reload.
